notes.title: Steam Deck Update! :D
notes.notes:
Hi all! Success! The title has been updated to Unreal engine 5 and I took this opportunity to completely overhaul the controller support for a nice, smooth experience on this lovely new handheld we've got.

Performance wise, MENOS already ran great on deck but controller support, while functional, wasn't very fun. 

The new configuration makes the transition between Telekinesis and Gunfighting way more seamless, makes navigating menus a lot easier and cleans up any cursor tracking issues I noticed on the previous version.

The Update to Unreal Engine 5 took a lot more work than I initially though it would (go figure) so I hope you enjoy the new and improved performance and pad support whether you game on deck or on the couch. 

Hopefully, the title will one day be Verified on deck but for now you'll just have to take my word for it ;)

Work on the Sequel, MENOS: PRECURSOR is coming along really well, hoping to launch a new and improved demo for the title in the coming months so stay tuned!

As always, thanks so much for playing, I hope you enjoy your time with MENOS!

-Jack

notes.title: Balancing update.
notes.notes:
-Enemies now only shoot when on screen.
-The range at which enemies can shoot is greatly increased, they can now shoot back when you're firing from a greater distance using the ALT/RB zoom but again, only when they're on screen.
-Improvements to the TK grab's effectiveness.

notes.title: Quick patch o'clock
notes.notes:
UPDATE: Also fixed the issue with enemies sometimes not taking damage from hitting the environment. 

Hi everyone, thanks a ton for checking out MENOS. I've noticed some people are having a little trouble grabbing enemies when they're charging at you so I've gone ahead and updated the enemies to run ever so slightly slower while also increasing the area of effect on the Telekinesis grab. 

Hopefully that sorts out any issues you may have been having.

If there's anything else come and shout at me on the forums and I'll get right on it. 

Thanks a million and have a good one.

-Jack
